title: Add unified artifact search API

context.summary: Add a project-scoped artifact search API across derived text, OCR, transcripts, image/video descriptions and face-backed source refs.
context.background: TASK-41 through TASK-47 write rich derived artifacts, but the public search surface still centers on document chunks.

in: Add core artifact search input/hit contracts.
Implement Drizzle artifact text-span search over current non-superseded processing runs.
Support artifact type filters, span type filters, project scopes, query text, metadata filters and result limits.
Return source refs and source positions for document/page/frame/time/face-backed artifacts.
Add POST /v1/artifacts/search and wire API runtime dependencies.
Add integration coverage for image OCR/caption, audio transcript and video keyframe search.
out: New vector storage for image/video/audio artifacts.
CLI, MCP or Hermes artifact search surfaces.

acceptance_criteria: Artifact search is project-scoped and enforces authorization.
Artifact search can filter by artifact type and span type.
Metadata filters are enforced through document_metadata_index.
Search results include artifact ids, artifact types, span metadata, source refs and source positions.
Image, audio and video derived artifacts are searchable through one API.

manual_checks: Confirm artifact search returns source refs for image/audio/video derived artifacts.

risks: This task adds full-text artifact search only; vector search for multimodal artifact embeddings remains future work.
The repository duplicates metadata-filter SQL used by document search until a shared query helper is extracted.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
